---
title: "Before the day"
---
The day is worked in R, inside an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), on a ready-made workspace that you download and check by following the setup page. Everything that the day needs ships inside the workspace: the first cohabitations that the course rebuilt from the public files of the National Survey of Family Growth (NSFG), which are in the public domain, and the file that Multi100 gave the five analysts, which the reproduction of Task 3 needs. There is nothing to register for and nothing else to download. The browser lab runs the same exercise in a browser tab and gives the same numbers, the reproduction of Task 3 included. The facilitator uses it on the shared screen, and it is the place to carry on if a machine fails.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd), sections 1 and 2 | The original study, its data and its model ([section 1](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd#sec-study)), and SCORE and the claim as Multi100 recorded it ([section 2](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd#sec-score)). Leave section 3 onwards for after the day: section 3 quotes the analyst who found what Task 3 asks you to find for yourself, and the later sections describe it. | 30 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Install R and an IDE, download the workspace zip and run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until it prints OK; the last check fits the reference specification of the course and prints −0.730. Open the [browser lab](../../cases/cohabitation/lab.qmd) once as well and confirm that it loads on the machine you will use. The [help page](../../help.qmd) has the problems that other participants have met. | 30 to 60 minutes, once |
| [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) | Optional. Where the console, the variables and the data viewer are in the IDE that you chose, and what changes between the three. | 30 minutes |
| [Exercise overview](../../cases/cohabitation/exercise.qmd#the-claim), the claim | Read the claim that you will be working on and the published result behind it. | 5 minutes |
| [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) | Optional. Worth the time if you have never written R: objects, data frames, reading a CSV file, the pipe and a first table, on the data of two other cases of the course. | An evening |

**By the start of the day** you have the workspace working on the machine that you will use, and you know what the claim is and which number of the paper Multi100 attached to it.
